said.caption:
Actually said. Oct 20 to Nov 11, 2026.

1. eBay, Oct 21, 2026 (Memo announcing about 1,000 job cuts): "Our strategy is working"
It is working. About a thousand people are not. (Our take.)

2. Netflix, Oct 20, 2026 (Letter to shareholders): "create member value that lets us occasionally raise prices"
Occasionally. (Our take.)

3. Kimberly-Clark, Nov 2, 2026 (SEC filing on an integration program): "workforce optimization (approximately $0.4 billion)"
The people are in the parentheses. (Our take.)

4. JetBlue, Nov 4, 2026 (Statement on higher bag fees): "This helps us keep our base fares competitive"
The fare stays competitive. The suitcase pays. (Our take.)

5. Verizon, Nov 11, 2026 (CEO, on cutting about 13,000 jobs): "I really needed to show that this was different"
Most people just send a memo. (Our take.)

The gray lines are real and untouched. The black lines are our take.

Sources: FOX 5 New York (Reuters), Oct 22, 2026; Netflix shareholder letter (SEC), Oct 20, 2026; Kimberly-Clark Form 8-K (SEC), Nov 2, 2026; AP via Hawaii News Now, Nov 4, 2026; Fortune, Nov 11, 2026.
